    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">做了一个网页天气可视化 2</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p style="font-size: 0; line-height: 0; margin: 0" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1 style="display: table; margin-right: auto; margin-bottom: 1em; margin-left: auto; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.5em 1em; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-size: 22.4px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); margin-top: 0 !important" data-heading="true"><span>做了一个网页天气可视化 2</span></h1>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>上一篇写完之后，本想先停一停的。</span><span>结果项目一开着就关不掉了。白天调太阳光斑，晚上改雷声，挂在副屏上跑着跑着，又开始觉得"这里还差一点，那里也还能再补"。于是它从一个"网页天气可视化 demo"，慢慢长成了一个我真的会开着用的东西。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>如果说第一篇写的是"怎么把雨、雪、雾这些视觉效果做出来"，那第二篇更像是后续更新记录：我把这个项目继续往"长期运行、可交互、可沉浸"的方向推了一大截。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这次主要更新了这些：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em">
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 声音系统全面重做——雷声、雨声、风声都有了，而且风向会影响左右声道</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 新增两种极端天气——冰雹和沙尘暴，从粒子到音效全套做完</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 世界地图选点——点哪看哪的天气，带 24 小时和 7 天预报时间线</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 沉浸模式、控制面板重做、深色主题，以及一轮继续往下抠的性能优化</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>开源地址：https://github.com/greywen/web-weather</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>在线体验：https://weather.anhejin.cn</span></p>
<hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>从"有画面"到"有气氛"——声音系统是怎么做的</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>第一版项目其实是静音的。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>视觉上已经有雨、有雾、有闪电，看着挺像回事，但一旦全屏挂到副屏上，就总觉得少了点什么。不是少一个特效，而是少了"环境"。真实天气打动人的地方，从来不只是你看到了什么，还包括你听到了什么。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>雷声合成：七层叠加</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>最开始我也想过偷懒，直接找几段雨声、雷声 MP3 循环播放就完了。但这么做有两个问题：重复感太强，控制粒度不够。尤其雷声这种东西，一旦你听到第三次完全一样的波形，沉浸感会瞬间消失。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>所以最后还是走了更麻烦的路：用 Web Audio API 合成。雷声被拆成了七个阶段，每个阶段都是独立的音频节点链路：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">// ═══ 1. THE CRACK — 闪电回击瞬间的尖锐爆点 + 短弧尾 ═══</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(snapBuf, now, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;1.2</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;hpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;1800</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;bpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;4800</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;distAmount</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.45</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;pan</span><span>: mainPan });</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(arcTailBuf, now +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.003</span><span>, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.42</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;hpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;900</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;bpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;2600</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;pan</span><span>: mainPan });</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// ═══ 2. SUB-BASS BOOM — 正弦波下扫，胸口被震一下的感觉 ═══</span></span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(bassBuf, now +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.005</span><span>, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;1.2</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;lpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;120</span><span>&nbsp;});</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// ═══ 3-4. RE-STRIKE — 分支闪电的二次、三次回击 ═══</span></span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(rs1Buf, now +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.045</span><span>&nbsp;+ random, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.68</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;pan</span><span>: mainPan + offset });</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(rs2Buf, rs1Time +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.03</span><span>&nbsp;+ random, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.4</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;pan</span><span>: -mainPan + offset });</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// ═══ 5. ROLLING RUMBLE — 远处滚动的低频隆隆声 ═══</span></span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(rumbleBuf, now +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.08</span><span>, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.55</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;lpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;250</span><span>&nbsp;});</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// ═══ 6-7. 延迟重击 + 远方余震 ═══</span></span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(bass2Buf, rs1Time +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.01</span><span>, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.7</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;lpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;90</span><span>&nbsp;});</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>playBuf</span></span><span>(distRumbleBuf, now +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.5</span><span>&nbsp;+ random, v *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.25</span><span>, {</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;lpFreq</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;150</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;pan</span><span>: random });</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这七层不是随便叠的。snap buffer 是采样级别逐个样本手搓的脉冲序列，模拟电弧击穿空气的尖锐感；crack 段用了高通滤波 + 稀疏脉冲 + tanh 饱和削波，避免听起来像廉价游戏音效；sub-bass 是一个从 80Hz 向下扫到 25Hz 的正弦波，加了二次和半频谐波，给整个雷声一个"下坠感"的低频冲击：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">// Sub-bass: 频率下扫合成</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>let</span></span><span>&nbsp;phase =</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span><span>;</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>for</span></span><span>&nbsp;(</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">let</span><span>&nbsp;i =</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span><span>; i &lt; len; i++) {</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; const</span></span><span>&nbsp;t = i / sr;</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; const</span></span><span>&nbsp;freq =</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;80</span><span>&nbsp;*</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">exp</span><span>(-t *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.8</span><span>) +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;25</span><span>;</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">&nbsp;// 80Hz → 25Hz 指数衰减</span><span>&nbsp; phase += (</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">2</span><span>&nbsp;*</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span>PI</span><span>&nbsp;* freq) / sr;</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; const</span></span><span>&nbsp;envelope =</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">exp</span><span>(-t *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;1.2</span><span>);</span><span>&nbsp; d[i] = (</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">sin</span><span>(phase) *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.7</span><span>&nbsp;+</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">sin</span><span>(phase *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;2</span><span>) *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.2</span><span>&nbsp;+</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">sin</span><span>(phase *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.5</span><span>) *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.3</span><span>)</span><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; * envelope *</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">tanh</span><span>(envelope *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;2</span><span>);</span><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>rumble 则是布朗噪声做的滚动尾音，双声道各自加了不同的随机漂移和不规则幅度调制，模拟声音在山谷或云层间反射的那种不均匀滚动感。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>最后面还挂了两级 delay-feedback network 做回响——一个短延迟（180-330ms）模拟近处反射，一个长延迟（400-700ms）模拟远处山体回声，都经过低通滤波让每次反馈越来越闷。整条总线再过一个 compressor，threshold -18dB，ratio 12:1，把瞬态炸峰压住。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这一整套做下来，效果最明显的不是"更真实"，而是"更耐听"。项目挂一小时，你不会因为那几段音频反复循环而烦躁。而且因为 snap / rumble buffer 各预生成了多个变体缓存在内存里，每次雷声都会从缓存里随机取，所以同样是"打雷"，每次听起来都不完全一样。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>环境声：雨声、风声、雪声的分层处理</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>雷声是一次性事件音效，但环境声（雨、风、雪）是持续背景音。这块也不是一段 MP3 循环那么简单。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>每种天气的环境声都由多个噪声层构成。拿雨声举例：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;createRainAmbient</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">ctx</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;AudioContext</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;dest</span><span>:</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;AudioNode</span><span>):</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;AmbientSet</span><span>&nbsp;{</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>&nbsp; // Layer 1: 雨体 — 带通滤波白噪声, 中心频率 3kHz, 模拟雨滴密集打击声</span></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; const</span></span><span>&nbsp;body =</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;createFilteredNoise</span><span>(ctx,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'bandpass'</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;3000</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.8</span><span>);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>&nbsp; // Layer 2: 低频轰鸣 — 低通 400Hz, 模拟大雨时整体环境的闷响</span></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; const</span></span><span>&nbsp;rumble =</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;createFilteredNoise</span><span>(ctx,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'lowpass'</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;400</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.6</span><span>);</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; return</span></span><span>&nbsp;{</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;layers</span><span>: [body, rumble], panner };</span><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>风声两层——600Hz 带通做主体风声，2kHz 窄带通做高频呼啸。雪天则只有一层极低音量的 800Hz 低通噪声，营造那种"世界突然安静下来"的感觉。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这些层的音量不是固定的，而是根据天气参数实时联动的。particleCount 控制雨量，speed 控制下落速度，两个参数组合影响雨声音量和滤波器频率：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">const</span><span>&nbsp;rainFactor = particleRatio *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.6</span><span>&nbsp;+ speedRatio *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.4</span><span>;</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>fadeTo</span></span><span>(rain.</span><span>layers</span><span>[</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0</span><span>].</span><span>gain</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.25</span><span>&nbsp;* rainFactor +</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.05</span><span>, fadeTime);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// 雨速越快，滤波频率越高，声音越 "沙沙" 而不是 "哗哗"</span></span><span>rain.</span><span>layers</span><span>[</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0</span><span>].</span><span>filter</span><span>.</span><span>frequency</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">setTargetAtTime</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)"><span>&nbsp; 2500</span></span><span>&nbsp;+ speedRatio *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;1500</span><span>, ctx.</span><span>currentTime</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.5</span><span>);</span></code></pre>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>风控制了左右声道</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这是声音系统里我最得意的一个小细节。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>所有环境声层都挂了 StereoPannerNode，而 panner 的 pan 值直接由风力滑块（config.wind）驱动：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">// 风从右边吹 → 声音偏右声道；风从左边吹 → 声音偏左</span><span>rain.</span><span>panner</span><span>.</span><span>pan</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">setTargetAtTime</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)"><span>&nbsp; Math</span></span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">max</span><span>(-</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">1</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">min</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">1</span><span>, config.</span><span>wind</span><span>&nbsp;/</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;3</span><span>)),</span><span>&nbsp; ctx.</span><span>currentTime</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.3</span><span>);</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>效果很简单但是非常直觉：你把风力滑块往右拖，雨声就渐渐偏向右耳；往左拖，声音往左耳移动。戴耳机的时候尤其明显，整个"风从哪边来"的方向感一下就有了。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>雷声也做了类似的处理。每次触发雷声时，主 crack 的 pan 位置是随机的（±0.25 范围），后面的 re-strike 会在主位置基础上偏移，最后的远方余震 pan 范围更大（±0.4），模拟闪电在天空中不同位置击中的空间感。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>当然，浏览器也不会这么轻易放过你。Web Audio 最大的经典问题就是 autoplay policy，不点一下页面，大多数浏览器根本不让你出声。所以我最后把整个 AudioContext 的初始化挂在用户首次交互上——你第一次点页面，才开始创建上下文、预生成 buffer、启动噪声源。</span></p>
<hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>新天气：冰雹——从天上砸下来的不只是圈圈</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>做完雨雪雾之后，总觉得天气种类还是太"温和"了。真实世界里的极端天气——冰雹、沙尘暴——才是能把氛围感拉满的东西。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>冰雹粒子：预渲染纹理 + 加速下落 + 弹跳碎裂</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>冰雹不是缩小版的雨滴。它是硬的、不规则的、有重量感的。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>粒子形状用 6 边不规则多边形模拟冰块的棱角感，但重点不在这里——重点是这些形状全部预渲染成了离屏 Canvas 纹理。一共 6 种尺寸，每种都带径向渐变（模拟冰的半透明质感）和一个小椭圆高光（模拟镜面反射）：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">// 预渲染冰雹纹理：径向渐变 + 高光</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>const</span></span><span>&nbsp;grad = tctx.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">createRadialGradient</span><span>(cx - size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.2</span><span>, cy - size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.2</span><span>, size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.1</span><span>, cx, cy, size);</span><span>grad.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">addColorStop</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'rgba(240, 248, 255, 0.85)'</span><span>);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">&nbsp; &nbsp;// 中心亮白</span><span>grad.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">addColorStop</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0.4</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'rgba(200, 220, 245, 0.65)'</span><span>);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">&nbsp;// 冰蓝过渡</span><span>grad.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">addColorStop</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">1</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'rgba(160, 190, 220, 0.35)'</span><span>);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">&nbsp; &nbsp;// 边缘半透明</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// 镜面高光</span></span><span>tctx.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">ellipse</span><span>(cx - size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.15</span><span>, cy - size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.2</span><span>, size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.25</span><span>, size *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.15</span><span>, -</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0.3</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span>PI</span><span>&nbsp;*</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;2</span><span>);</span><span>tctx.</span><span>fillStyle</span><span>&nbsp;=</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'</span><span>;</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>运行时直接 drawImage 贴图，不用每帧重新创建渐变。150 颗冰雹一起画，开销和画 150 个矩形差不多。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>下落不是匀速的。冰雹有加速度（每帧 speed += 0.18），速度上限很高（14-20），加上旋转（每颗粒子有独立的旋转角速度），视觉上就是"从高处狠砸下来"的感觉，而不是"缓缓飘落"。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>最有意思的是砸到地面之后的反应。冰雹落地会同时触发两个子系统：</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">弹跳碎片（hailBounce）</strong><span>：每颗冰雹落地时溅射 2-3 个三角形碎片，向上弹起然后受重力回落，存活时间不到半秒。用 120 个预分配的对象池管理，spawn 时写入下一个空槽，死亡时 swap-and-pop，零分配。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; font-size: inherit">地面碎冰（groundIce）</strong><span>：碎片落地后不会消失，而是留在地面堆积。500 个碎冰块，9 种预渲染纹理（3 种形状 × 3 种大小），每块都有独立的生命周期。这里有个细节——冰雹天气的背景是有雨的（雨量较小），而雨量会影响碎冰的融化速率：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">const</span><span>&nbsp;rainAmount = configRef.</span><span>current</span><span>.</span><span>particleCount</span><span>;</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>const</span></span><span>&nbsp;baseMelt =</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.0004</span><span>;</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>const</span></span><span>&nbsp;melt = baseMelt + rainAmount *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.0002</span><span>;</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">&nbsp;// 雨越大，冰融化越快</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>所以你会看到：冰雹砸下来，碎冰堆积在地面，同时背景有小雨，碎冰在雨中慢慢消融。如果碎冰池满了，新碎冰会替换掉生命值最低的那块——这个策略保证了地面碎冰数量稳定，不会无限增长。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>音效方面，冰雹用的是预录制的 hail.mp3 循环播放（这个用合成反而不自然），音量跟冰雹数量联动。背景同时叠加了雨声和风声层，整体听起来就是一场混杂着噼噼啪啪冰粒声的暴风雨。</span></p>
<img class="rich_pages wxw-img lazyload" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/809672/202603/809672-20260328103553398-190381165.gif" data-ratio="0.5645833333333333" data-type="gif" data-w="480" data-imgfileid="100000037" data-aistatus="1"><hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>新天气：沙尘暴——三层粒子 + 碎屑系统</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>沙尘暴是这次新增的两种天气里视觉层次最丰富的一个。不是因为它最难做，而是因为真实沙尘暴的"信息量"比别的天气大：有细沙、有碎屑、有地面扬尘、有整体色调偏移，全部叠在一起才像回事。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>沙粒层：350 颗不规则多边形</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>沙粒不是圆形，是 3-6 边的随机多边形。启动时预生成 12 种形状模板，运行时每颗粒子随机索引一种。三组颜色——暖沙&nbsp;</span><code style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px"><span>rgb(180,155,100)</span></code><span>、深沙&nbsp;</span><code style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px"><span>rgb(160,135,85)</span></code><span>、亮沙&nbsp;</span><code style="font-size: 90%; color: rgba(221, 17, 68, 1); background: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); padding: 3px 5px; border-radius: 4px"><span>rgb(195,170,120)</span></code><span>——按 colorShift 分配，避免所有粒子都是一个色。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>移动轨迹不是直线。水平方向跟随风速和风向，垂直方向有正弦波摆动（wobble），每颗粒子的摆动频率和幅度都不一样：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">this</span><span>.</span><span>x</span><span>[i] += (</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">this</span><span>.</span><span>speed</span><span>[i] + absWind *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;2</span><span>) * speedMult * dir;</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>this</span></span><span>.</span><span>y</span><span>[i] +=</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">&nbsp;Math</span><span>.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">sin</span><span>(now *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.0006</span><span>&nbsp;+</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;this</span><span>.</span><span>wobble</span><span>[i]) *</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;this</span><span>.</span><span>wobbleAmp</span><span>[i];</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>this</span></span><span>.</span><span>rotation</span><span>[i] +=</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;this</span><span>.</span><span>rotSpeed</span><span>[i] * speedMult;</span></code></pre>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>碎屑层：会翻滚的树枝、树叶和小石子</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>沙尘暴不只是沙子。空气里还夹杂着被风卷起来的杂物。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>我定义了 5 种碎屑类型——树枝（twig）、树叶（leaf）、小石子（rock）、塑料片（scrap）、泥块（clump）——每种都有独立的手绘形状。树枝是几段折线，树叶是贝塞尔曲线填充，石子是不规则多边形，塑料片是带弯曲的长条。最多 25 个碎屑，这个数量不能多，否则画面会太乱。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>地面扬尘：贴地滚动的圆形尘团</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>靠近地面的部分有一层贴地滚动的沙团（groundSand），60 个半透明圆形，从一侧滚到另一侧后淡出消失。这一层给整个画面底部一种"沙子在脚下翻涌"的感觉。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>整体色调：全局沙色覆盖</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>最上面还盖了一层全屏的半透明沙色蒙版，密度跟 sandDensity 参数联动。密度高的时候，画面上下各有一条沙色渐变带，模拟近地面和高空能见度降低的效果：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)">// 全画面沙色蒙版</span><span>ctx.</span><span>fillStyle</span><span>&nbsp;=</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)"><span>&nbsp;`rgba(180, 140, 70,</span><span style="color: rgba(201, 209, 217, 1)"><span>&nbsp;${sandDensity *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)"><span>&nbsp;0.25</span></span><span>}</span></span><span>)`</span></span><span>;</span><span>ctx.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">fillRect</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span><span>, width, height);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>// 密度 &gt;= 0.3 时，顶部和底部加重的沙尘带</span></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>if</span></span><span>&nbsp;(sandDensity &gt;=</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.3</span><span>) {</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; const</span></span><span>&nbsp;topGrad = ctx.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">createLinearGradient</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0</span><span>, height *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">&nbsp;0.25</span><span>);</span><span>&nbsp; topGrad.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">addColorStop</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">0</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)"><span>&nbsp;`rgba(160, 120, 50,</span><span style="color: rgba(201, 209, 217, 1)"><span>&nbsp;${sandDensity *</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)"><span>&nbsp;0.3</span></span><span>}</span></span><span>)`</span></span><span>);</span><span>&nbsp; topGrad.</span><span style="color: rgba(210, 168, 255, 1)">addColorStop</span><span>(</span><span style="color: rgba(121, 192, 255, 1)">1</span><span>,</span><span style="color: rgba(165, 214, 255, 1)">&nbsp;'transparent'</span><span>);</span><span style="color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 1)"><span>&nbsp; // ...</span></span><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>音效方面，沙尘暴用了 sandstorm.mp3 循环样本，音量跟密度和风速双重联动。同时风声层也会自动拉满，毕竟没有大风就不会有沙尘暴。</span></p>
<img class="rich_pages wxw-img lazyload" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/809672/202603/809672-20260328103553123-876139450.gif" data-ratio="0.5645833333333333" data-type="gif" data-w="480" data-imgfileid="100000036" data-aistatus="1"><hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>世界地图：点哪儿看哪儿的天气</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>第一版的自动模式只能读浏览器定位，看自己所在城市的天气。这次加了世界地图——地图上任意点一下，就能看那个位置的实时天气。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>为什么不做城市选择器</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>一开始我考虑过做一个下拉列表选城市。但很快就放弃了。城市列表要维护，数据不全的城市定位不准，而且一个列表最多放几百个城市名。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>地图直接点击就不一样了：经纬度是连续的，你可以点撒哈拉沙漠中间、可以点南极大陆、可以点太平洋正中央。有没有城市不重要，Open-Meteo 只要经纬度就能返回天气数据。</span></p>
<h3 style="margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 12px; font-size: 19.2px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(0, 152, 116, 1)" data-heading="true"><span>天气预报时间线</span></h3>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>既然已经有了位置，顺手就把预报数据也用上了。Open-Meteo 的同一个 API 请求里可以带 hourly 和 daily 参数，额外返回 24 小时逐小时预报和 7 天逐日预报。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这些数据渲染成了一个可折叠的时间线面板。小时预报是横向滚动的卡片列表，每张卡片显示时间、天气图标、温度和降水量，当前小时会高亮。日预报是纵向列表，每行显示星期、图标、最低/最高温度，中间有一条渐变的温度范围条。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这一块交互上没什么特别的，但有一个细节：温度单位可以在摄氏度和华氏度之间切换，切换后整个时间线的温度显示会即时刷新。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>所以现在你可以这样玩：点开地图，搜 "Reykjavik"，看冰岛现在在下什么；然后切到 "Dubai"，看沙漠里的天气；再切 "Tokyo"，看东京的梅雨季——每个地方的天气参数完全不同，Canvas 里的效果也跟着变。某种意义上这不再只是一个"天气可视化"，而是一个"天气体验器"。</span></p>
<img class="rich_pages wxw-img lazyload" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/809672/202603/809672-20260328103553094-737672705.gif" data-ratio="0.5645833333333333" data-type="gif" data-w="480" data-imgfileid="100000035" data-aistatus="1"><hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>沉浸模式，本质上是在认真对待"副屏动态壁纸"这个场景</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>上一篇文章最后我提过，我会把这个项目开在家里第二块屏幕上跑。后来我发现，如果真把它当"桌面氛围层"来用，那界面逻辑就不能还是一个普通演示页的思路。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>你不可能让一个侧边栏一直糊在画面上。控制面板、GitHub 按钮、语言切换，全都摆在那里，再好的天气效果也会被 UI 打断。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>所以这次我单独做了一个沉浸模式。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>进入后会直接请求浏览器全屏，主面板隐藏，只在左上角保留一个很小的状态 badge，显示当前天气和自动/手动状态。想调参数的时候，再点开面板；不调的时候，整个页面尽量只剩天气本身。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>代码上倒不复杂，核心就是 Fullscreen API：</span></p>
<pre><code style="font-size: 90%; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1em 1em; overflow-x: auto; color: inherit; background: none; white-space-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;Fira Code&quot;, Menlo, &quot;Operator Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, monospace"><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">if</span><span>&nbsp;(enterImmersive) {</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; document</span></span><span>.</span><span>documentElement</span><span>.</span><span>requestFullscreen</span><span>?.();</span><span>}</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;else</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">&nbsp;if</span><span>&nbsp;(</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)">document</span><span>.</span><span>fullscreenElement</span><span>) {</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 123, 114, 1)"><span>&nbsp; document</span></span><span>.</span><span>exitFullscreen</span><span>?.();</span><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>真正要处理的是边界情况。比如用户按 Escape 退出全屏，UI 状态不能还傻傻地以为自己在 immersive mode 里，不然按钮状态和真实页面状态会不同步。所以我又监听了 fullscreenchange，把 React 状态反向同步回来。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这种东西写起来没技术含量，但不补的话体验会很糟。很多 demo 之所以始终是 demo，不是因为效果不够酷，而是因为它们没认真处理这些"你真的会拿来用吗"的问题。</span></p>
<hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>性能这次没大改架构，但继续把一些不值当的开销砍掉了</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>第一篇里我已经写过 SoA、对象池、批量绘制这些优化，这次主要是继续清理一些"肉眼不一定看得到，但设备会很诚实地告诉你它难受"的地方。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>冰雹的预渲染纹理是这次最典型的优化案例。150 颗冰雹，每颗是不规则多边形 + 径向渐变 + 高光椭圆，如果每帧现画，就是 150 次 createRadialGradient + 150 次多边形路径构建 + 150 次椭圆绘制。改成 6 张预渲染纹理之后，运行时就是 150 次 drawImage，开销直接降了一个数量级。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>沙尘暴也是类似思路。12 种沙粒形状预生成顶点数组，运行时只做平移、旋转、填充。碎屑的 5 种类型各自有固定的绘制路径，不用每帧重新计算形状。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>雷声的 buffer 缓存也值得一提。buildLightningSnapBuffer、buildSubBassBuffer、buildRumbleBuffer 这些函数调一次要遍历几万个采样点做数学运算，如果每次打雷都重新算，延迟会非常明显。现在所有 buffer 在第一次触发时生成并缓存，后续直接从 cache 里取，snaps 缓存 3 个变体、bass 缓存 2 个、rumble 缓存 2 个，共 7 段 buffer 覆盖所有组合。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>雷电的视觉绘制还是上次的双层线条方案——粗淡外轮廓 + 细亮芯线。单纯画亮线不难，难的是闪的时候别把 GPU/CPU 一起拖慢，shadowBlur 是绝对不碰的。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>这类优化的共同点是：它们不会让截图变得更惊艳，但会决定项目能不能在一台普通电脑上安静地跑一整天。</span></p>
<hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 style="display: table; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); text-align: center; padding: 0.3em 1em; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 20.8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)" data-heading="true"><span>这次更新让我更确定一件事：网页特效项目最难的不是"做"，而是"收"</span></h2>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>如果只是为了发个视频，很多东西都可以往上堆。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>多一层 glow，多一层 noise，多一个模式，多一个按钮，看起来好像都在"增强项目"。但当你真的把它当成一个可以打开、切换、悬挂、长期运行的网页应用去看，问题就变了。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>你得考虑：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1); list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em">
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 冰雹的碎冰堆积到 500 块之后怎么办</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 沙尘暴的三层粒子系统会不会把低端设备拖垮</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 切到东京的天气数据后，声音系统的音量跳变会不会吓到人</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 地图组件差不多 400 行代码，SSR 不能渲染怎么处理</span></li>
<li style="display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px"><span>• 用户在赤道选了一个点之后想切回自己的定位，状态怎么恢复</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>说白了，越往后做，这个项目就越不像一个"特效合集"，反而越来越像一个小型系统。视觉、状态、交互、性能、音频、地理数据，最后都缠在一起。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>也是因为这个，我现在反而不太在意它是不是"代码优雅"。它当然还能继续拆、继续抽、继续模块化，但对我来说，这一轮更新最重要的收获不是文件结构更漂亮，而是这个项目终于有了明确的使用场景——打开它，选一个地方，听着那里的天气，挂上一整天。</span></p>
<hr style="border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>接下来如果我还继续做，可能会往两个方向走。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>一个方向是继续补环境细节——雨天玻璃挂水、远处城市灯光在雾里的扩散、更自然的云层分层，这些一直在脑子里转但还没动手的东西。另一个方向则是工程侧的收拾，把一个越来越膨胀的 Canvas 组件拆得更清楚一点，毕竟 WeatherCanvas.tsx 已经一千好几百行了，再加新天气类型就不太好维护了。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>当然，也可能我又突然去做别的坑了。</span></p>
<p style="margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(63, 63, 63, 1)"><span>如果你对这类"网页里的环境模拟"也有兴趣，欢迎直接拿项目改，或者告诉我还有哪些天气细节值得往里塞。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: 0; line-height: 0; margin: 0"><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p style="font-size: 0; line-height: 0; margin: 0" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p style="font-size: 0; line-height: 0; margin: 0"><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

</div>
